notes.title: Update 0.1.0a
notes.notes:
A quick update before playtesting.


Additions
-An option to fade out the HUD when not in use has been added to the options menu.

-You can now set the time limit when creating a custom game.


Changes
-Graffiti Can now leaves paint streaks on designated graffiti spots.

-Camcorder has been reworked to have more consistency when gathering footage.


Fixes
-Fixed various networking issues
